system.description: Deathless characters continue to exist after ordinary biological life has ended or are sustained in a condition between life and death. Their continued existence may depend upon necromancy, spiritual force, hunger, memory, shadow, unfinished purpose, or another extraordinary condition.

nature.name: Deathless Nature
nature.text: You do not need to breathe or eat and do not sleep in the ordinary manner. Ordinary biological diseases and poisons do not affect you, though you must still rest and recover normally. Deathless Nature - Playtest: your Death Track ends at 7 instead of 5. When all five Core Wound spaces first fill, become Dying at 0/7; reaching 7 causes death. Advancement of the Death Track, exertion while Dying, additional Wounds, Stabilization, retained progress, and recovery otherwise follow the normal rules. Your Core Wound track still has five spaces. Choose one Deathless Species Trait.

traits.name: Borrowed Life
traits.text: After one minute of preparation, you may imitate warmth, breathing, coloration, a heartbeat, and similar signs of life. This is not Concentration. The effect lasts until you end it, replace it, or become unconscious. Ordinary observation cannot identify you as Deathless; medical or supernatural examination may reveal your nature.

traits.name: Detached Scout
traits.text: Use Perform Task to detach or reattach one small sensory part within reach, burning its normal 2 Action dice in Combat. Choose one ordinary Sense to perceive through the part. Within 5 units, you receive that Sense from the part's position with its normal limitations. Your main body loses the corresponding Sense or function while the part is detached. The part cannot move or act and grants no extra Actions. Perception costs no further dice. It stops if the part is destroyed or moves beyond 5 units, and resumes if the intact part returns within range. Reattachment restores the body's function. If the part is destroyed, appropriate care during a Recovery restores both the part and its function.

traits.name: Grave Sense
traits.text: Within 3 units, pinpoint creatures and remains and distinguish living, dead, Deathless, and artificially animated subjects. Ordinary visual concealment does not block this Sense; a sealed barrier or an effect explicitly masking this detection does. It does not reveal identity, thoughts, cause of death, or concealed abilities. Empty objects without life, remains, or animation do not register.

traits.name: Shadowed Soul
traits.text: The first time each turn you enter dim light or darkness, move 1 additional unit without spending Movement.

traits.name: Spectral Flexibility
traits.text: You may pass through openings your spectral body and equipment can actually fit through, bypassing the usual one-Size squeezing limit. Apply the normal squeezing Movement cost and −1 Fortitude. You may move through creatures’ spaces but cannot end in a space still occupied by a conscious creature, or pass through solid walls or sealed barriers.

traits.name: Stitched Form
traits.text: You possess an additional arm, skeletal limb, tendril, or other appendage. It may hold and use one small item that can be used with one hand, other than a weapon or Guard. The item itself occupies equipment capacity normally. The limb does not grant additional Actions.

traits.name: Uncanny Stillness
traits.text: You can remain motionless indefinitely and display no involuntary signs of life. While Hidden and motionless, ordinary visual observation does not reveal you unless someone performs a deliberate search.

traits.name: Unyielding Remains
traits.text: The first time each Adventure a Wound Condition would reduce your Movement, disable a limb, or impair one of your Senses, ignore that portion of the Condition for one minute (six Rounds).
